title: Cold Air Cuts Your Nose's Virus Shield by 42% 🥶 #shorts
description:
Max steps into −5°C without a coat and we follow the cold inside: skin vessels clamp shut, warm blood retreats to protect the heart, and shivering kicks in.
The surprise: a nose just 5°C colder loses about 42% of its virus-fighting shield, so cold air doesn't give you a cold, it opens the door.
How long would YOU last outside without a coat? Tell us in the comments 👇
